name: Bifrost Power of 10 C++ coding standard
description: Buildable Power of 10 coding-standard policies mirrored from the public CodeQL C/C++ query pack.

policies.severity_rationale: Dynamic allocation after initialization adds unbounded lifetime and failure behavior to a safety-critical program.
policies.remediation: Allocate during initialization or use a reviewed bounded-storage strategy for later work.

policies.severity_rationale: Non-local jumps defeat the simple, bounded control-flow model required by Power of 10.
policies.remediation: Replace setjmp or longjmp with structured control flow and explicit error propagation.
